PRIVACY POLICY

Last updated: January 2025

WHO WE ARE

PotatoGameDev is an indie game studio. We make small, fun games. We are not interested in your data — we're interested in making good games.

WHAT WE COLLECT

Spud Runner does not collect any personal information. We do not require an account, email address, or any identifying details to play.

THIRD PARTY SERVICES

If the game is distributed via a platform (itch.io, Steam, etc.), that platform's own privacy policy applies. We have no control over what they collect.

CONTACT

Questions? Email us at hello@potatogamedev.com
